title: Faith During Life's Storms
body:
# Faith During Life's Storms
> Theme: Trusting God during difficult seasons
**Main Text:** Mark 4:35-41

## Introduction
Life often presents storms that challenge our faith. The disciples were obeying Jesus when the storm came.

## I. Storms Are Part of Life
- Jesus told us to expect trouble: John 16:33
- Obedience does not exempt us from storms: Mark 4:35-37

## II. Jesus Is Present in the Storm
- He was in the boat: Mark 4:38
- He has promised never to leave us: Hebrews 13:5

## III. Faith Overcomes Fear
- "Why are ye so fearful?" Mark 4:40
- God strengthens and upholds us: Isaiah 41:10

## Application
1. Trust God even when circumstances seem uncertain.
2. Wake Jesus up: bring the storm to Him in prayer.

## Discussion Questions
- Where are you in a storm right now?
- What does it mean that Jesus was "in the boat"?

## Conclusion
The same Jesus who calmed the sea can calm the storms in our lives.

## Invitation
==Will you trust Him today?==

title: Love Your Enemies
body:
# Love Your Enemies
> Theme: The radical love of the Kingdom
**Main Text:** Matthew 5:43-48

## Introduction
Jesus' command is not natural. It is supernatural.

## I. The Command
- "Love your enemies": Matthew 5:44
- Parallel: Luke 6:27-36

## II. The Pattern
- God shows mercy to the undeserving: Romans 5:8
- We forgive as we were forgiven: Ephesians 4:32

## III. The Practice
- Pray for those who wrong you.
- Overcome evil with good: Romans 12:21

## Application
1. Pray by name for one difficult person this week.
2. Do one unexpected kindness.

## Conclusion
Love for enemies shows the world whose children we are.

title: The Shepherd Who Walks With Us
body:
# The Shepherd Who Walks With Us
> Theme: God's care in every season
**Main Text:** Psalm 23

## Introduction
Psalm 23 has comforted believers for centuries. Read it slowly.

## I. He Provides (v. 1-3)
- "I shall not want": Psalm 23:1
- Rest and restoration: Psalm 23:2-3

## II. He Accompanies (v. 4)
- The valley is real, but so is His presence: Psalm 23:4
- Compare Isaiah 41:10 and Hebrews 13:5

## III. He Welcomes Us Home (v. 5-6)
- A table, an anointing, an overflowing cup: Psalm 23:5
- Goodness and mercy follow us: Psalm 23:6

## Application
Name your valley and read this psalm aloud each morning this week.

## Conclusion
The Lord is our shepherd - not just for a season, but for ever.
